title: route_to_model_loop emits model.route and model.outcome per iteration
goal: Add per-iteration model.route and model.outcome event emission to route_to_model_loop, with token parsing, and assert both call paths reach the shared emitters.

steps.description: Write the test first (TDD). Create tests/integration/router-loop-emits-model-events-test.sh with a stubbed claude that returns a well-formed JSON envelope. Assert: (S1) a single route_to_model_loop call emits model.route with tier, model_id and provider; (S2) emits model.outcome with input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens and cost_usd; (S3) a 3-iteration loop produces exactly 3 model.route and 3 model.outcome events, matching its 3 ledger rows; (S5) both route_to_model and route_to_model_loop are called in the same test run so an assertion on the shared emitters fires for both paths. Run the test against the unmodified merge-base to confirm it fails for the right reason.

Emit model.route before each iteration's spawn. In route_to_model_loop, immediately after the eb_emit_event 'loop.iteration' call (currently line ~1829), add: _route_emit_model_route "$tier" "$secs". This mirrors the sync path (route_to_model line 203) and gives per-iteration attribution of tier, model_id, provider, override_source and timeout_s before any token cost is incurred.

Parse per-iteration token globals and emit model.outcome in the loop success path. After the existing _route_record_call / _route_update_ledger pair (currently lines ~2343-2344) in the loop's success branch, assign _ROUTE_INPUT_TOKENS=$in_tok and _ROUTE_OUTPUT_TOKENS=$out_tok (already extracted into local vars above), then parse _ROUTE_CACHE_READ and _ROUTE_CACHE_CREATION from $json_file (matching the sync-path pattern at lines 1306-1307), then call _route_emit_outcome "$tier" "$secs". The placement after _route_record_call ensures _ROUTE_CALL_COST and _ROUTE_MODEL_USED are populated before _route_emit_outcome reads them.

Run the full test suite (npm test) and confirm: (a) the new test passes, (b) the golden-contracts-test passes (model.route and model.outcome golden files are unchanged — the loop emitters call the same functions as the sync path), (c) existing router-cache-metrics-test, router-precondition-test and router-loop-* tests remain green. If any golden needs updating due to event-sequence ordering changes, update those files in this step.

notes: Placement of _route_emit_model_route: it goes after eb_emit_event 'loop.iteration' (line ~1829) so the route-announcement event lands on the bus before any actual API cost is incurred, matching the sync path ordering (emit-route then check-budget then call). The budget check (_route_check_budget) already sits earlier in the per-iteration block (line ~1751) so there is no ordering conflict with the existing budget gate. Placement of _route_emit_outcome: must be after _route_record_call (so _ROUTE_CALL_COST is valid) and after the local in_tok/out_tok are extracted (so the per-iteration values, not zero from a prior iteration, go into _ROUTE_INPUT_TOKENS/_ROUTE_OUTPUT_TOKENS). The loop accumulates cumulative totals in _ROUTE_LOOP_INPUT_TOKENS/_ROUTE_LOOP_OUTPUT_TOKENS; the per-iteration assignment to _ROUTE_INPUT_TOKENS/_ROUTE_OUTPUT_TOKENS is a separate write — no double-counting. Cache token variables (_ROUTE_CACHE_READ, _ROUTE_CACHE_CREATION) have no loop-level accumulator counterpart, so only the per-iteration assignment is needed. The test stub must output stream-json format (the loop uses --output-format stream-json --verbose) and a final result line with the JSON envelope including .usage. The test should set ZBUILD_SCOPE_OVERRIDE=1 and skip the redaction precondition (or pre-seed the event log) to match the pattern in router-loop-stream-capture-test.sh. No golden file update is expected because _route_emit_model_route and _route_emit_outcome write the same field sets they always have; no new fields are added. ADR-003 is grandfathered in config/adr-enforcement-baseline.txt — no ## Enforced by section is required in this PR. The issue says 'land before #1699', which reshapes ledger rows; this PR adds event emission only and does not touch ledger row format, so there is no conflict.
